name: admission_place_confirmed
description: Sent to the parent when the child is admitted and becomes a pupil.
subject: Welcome to {school_name}: {child_first_name} has joined us
body: We are delighted to confirm that {child_first_name} has joined Year {year_group} at {school_name}, starting on {start_date}.
{child_first_name} has been sent their own sign-in details at their school e-mail address.
You are recorded as {child_first_name}'s first contact. Please tell us straight away if your contact details change.

placeholders.child_first_name: The child's preferred or first name
placeholders.child_name: The child's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.academic_year: The academic year applied for, e.g. 2026/27
